msg: Hi there! We're a family from Canada staying in Cartagena next month. My wife and I are both Advanced Open Water divers, and we have two kids, aged 11 and 7. What could each of us do on a day trip from Cartagena, and how much would it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The Rosario Islands are a lovely choice for a family day out! From Cartagena, the day trip includes a boat ride, lunch, and a return to the city the same day.

- *You and your wife:* As certified divers, you can each do two guided reef dives. The online price is available when booking directly through our website. - *Your 11-year-old:* If certified, they can join the two-dive trip too; the minimum age is 10. - *Your 7-year-old:* The minimum age for diving activities is 10, and Bubble Makers is for ages 8–10, so that program isn’t available for them. I don’t have another age-appropriate activity listed for a 7-year-old.

I’m leaving the prices below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD

Would you like to book the certified dives or the Mini Course?

msg: Thanks. Our 11-year-old has never dived, he isn't certified. And our daughter is the 7-year-old: so is there really nothing she can do? We can't leave her behind, so would she just stay on the boat while the rest of us are in the water?
reply:
Your 11-year-old can join the *Dive Mini Course*—no prior certification is needed, and the minimum age is 10. Your 7-year-old can join the *snorkeling tour* (minimum age 6), so she can enjoy the reef from the surface rather than staying on the boat. Both include the boat trip and lunch. Minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD

Shall we go for the *2-dive trip* for you and, for your companion, the *mini-course*, *snorkeling* or just coming along on the *boat*? 🌊

msg: That's better, thank you. So my wife and I would do the 2 dives, our son the mini course and our daughter the snorkeling. If both of us are diving, who stays with our daughter while she's snorkeling, given she has to be accompanied? And do we all go on the same boat?
reply:
Your daughter must be accompanied by a responsible adult while snorkeling, so both of you diving would leave that requirement unresolved. The snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dive sites. If there are few people, everyone travels on the same boat; otherwise, the group is split by activity. The team can confirm how the supervision and boat arrangements work for your group.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?

msg: No, we both dived last year. All right, how do I actually book all this, and how do we sort out the question about our daughter?
reply:
Your daughter can snorkel, but she must be accompanied by a responsible adult. Since both of you plan to dive, please have the team clarify how to arrange supervision for her before booking. Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor?
